name: frontend-design
description: Build or reshape distinctive frontend interfaces with intentional visual direction, typography, and layout. Use when creating or redesigning web UI.

name: web-design-guidelines
description: Review UI code for accessibility, interaction, performance, and web interface guideline compliance. Use when auditing web UI, UX, or accessibility.

name: tdd
description: Implement features or fixes through a red-green-refactor test-driven development loop. Use when the user explicitly requests test-first development or integration tests.

name: pdf
description: Read, create, edit, render, and verify PDF files. Use when the requested input or deliverable is a PDF.

name: say-it-clearly
description: Rewrite the immediately preceding assistant answer in concise natural Chinese. Use when the user says the answer was unclear, too long, or asks to hear the point again.

name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
description: Generate premium mobile app screen concept images. Use when the requested deliverable is a mobile UI bitmap rather than a product design workflow or code.

name: codebase-design
description: Design or improve a deep module interface and decide where a code seam belongs. Use for module-level boundaries and AI-navigable code design.

name: domain-modeling
description: Build a project's domain model, ubiquitous language, and related architectural decisions. Use when terminology and domain concepts are the primary deliverable.
